items.title: The conormal sequence of a composed immersion of spaces is exact and etale-locally split when the inner piece is H_1-regular
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For immersions Z -> Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S with Z -> Y H_1-regular (conormal sheaf finite locally free and the immersion quasi-regular), the lemma upgrades the general right-exact conormal sequence (chapter lemma transitivity-conormal) to a short exact sequence which is etale-locally on X a split sequence of finite locally free modules. The retained proof is written: since C_{Z/Y} is finite locally free (the two chapter lemmas quasi-regular-immersion and regular-quasi-regular-immersion identify H_1-regularity with local complete intersection structure and give the finite locally free conormal), local splitting reduces to exactness; right exactness is already known, so only injectivity of the first map remains; exactness of sequences of quasi-coherent modules can be checked etale locally on X, reducing to the schemes theorem (Divisors, lemma transitivity-conormal-quasi-regular). Retained author proof at lines 10637-10648.
